items.title: Maharashtra's plan to bring private universities under FRA sparks political debate
items.text: Maharashtra is proposing to bring self-financed universities under the Fee Regulatory Authority to regulate their fees. This has led to differing opinions among political leaders and ministers regarding its implications. While some support the regulation, others question the government's jurisdiction over certain institutions. Allegations of corruption and inflated fees have intensified scrutiny of the current fee regulation system. The government plans to present legislation in March to enforce these changes.
items.summary: Maharashtra proposes bringing self-financed universities under the Fee Regulatory Authority to regulate fees, causing political debate. Some support regulation, others question jurisdiction. Legislation planned for March.
items.title_hi: महाराष्ट्र की निजी विश्वविद्यालयों को FRA के तहत लाने की योजना पर राजनीतिक बहस
items.summary_hi: महाराष्ट्र स्व-वित्तपोषित विश्वविद्यालयों को शुल्क नियामक प्राधिकरण के तहत लाकर उनकी फीस नियंत्रित करना चाहता है, जिससे राजनीतिक बहस छिड़ गई है। कुछ इसका समर्थन करते हैं तो अन्य अधिकार क्षेत्र पर सवाल उठाते हैं। सरकार मार्च में विधेयक लाने की योजना बना रही है।

items.title: 'Crisis in Indian politics': Rahul Gandhi questions 2024 Lok Sabha mandate, alleges democracy was ‘destroyed’ in India in 2014
items.text: Rahul Gandhi spoke at the Bharat Summit 2026 in Hyderabad, claiming that democracy in India has been undermined. He alleged that the 2014 general election introduced unprecedented funding into the political system. Gandhi expressed concerns over the credibility of the upcoming 2024 Lok Sabha elections and pointed out discrepancies in voter data. He also noted the addition of new voters in Maharashtra ahead of the Assembly polls.
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi spoke at the Bharat Summit 2026 in Hyderabad, claiming democracy in India has been undermined since 2014. He raised concerns about the 2024 Lok Sabha elections and pointed to voter data discrepancies and new voters added in Maharashtra before Assembly polls.
items.title_hi: 'भारतीय राजनीति में संकट': राहुल गांधी ने 2024 लोकसभा जनादेश पर सवाल उठाया, आरोप लगाया कि 2014 में लोकतंत्र 'नष्ट' हुआ
items.summary_hi: राहुल गांधी ने हैदराबाद में भारत शिखर सम्मेलन 2026 में कहा कि 2014 से भारत में लोकतंत्र कमजोर हुआ है। उन्होंने 2024 लोकसभा चुनावों की विश्वसनीयता पर चिंता जताई और मतदाता डेटा में विसंगतियों तथा महाराष्ट्र विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले नए मतदाता जोड़े जाने का उल्लेख किया।

items.title: KLE Society’s 111th Foundation Day celebrated by collecting 300 units of blood
items.text: KLE Technological University celebrated the 111th Foundation Day of KLE Society in Hubballi on Friday, by paying tribute to its founders and organising a voluntary blood donation camp in which over 300 units of blood were collected.
items.summary: KLE Technological University celebrated KLE Society's 111th Foundation Day in Hubballi with a blood donation camp collecting over 300 units.
items.title_hi: KLE सोसायटी के 111वें स्थापना दिवस पर 300 यूनिट रक्त एकत्रित
items.summary_hi: KLE टेक्नोलॉजिकल यूनिवर्सिटी ने हुबली में KLE सोसायटी का 111वां स्थापना दिवस मनाया और रक्तदान शिविर में 300 यूनिट से अधिक रक्त एकत्र किया।

items.title: TVS Srichakra Q2 Results: Profit jumps nearly four-fold as revenue rises 37.5%
items.summary: TVS Srichakra reported a nearly four-fold jump in profit for Q2 as revenue rose 37.5%.
items.title_hi: TVS श्रीचक्र Q2 परिणाम: मुनाफा लगभग चार गुना बढ़ा, राजस्व 37.5% बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: TVS श्रीचक्र ने Q2 में मुनाफे में लगभग चार गुना वृद्धि दर्ज की है जबकि राजस्व 37.5% बढ़ा है।

items.summary: Priyank Kharge stated the government is committed to supporting startups in Kalyana Karnataka. Kalaburagi aims to increase its contribution to the State GDP from 1.9% to 3%.
items.title_hi: कल्याण कर्नाटक में स्टार्टअप्स का समर्थन करने के लिए सरकार प्रतिबद्ध: प्रियांक खड़गे
items.summary_hi: प्रियांक खड़गे ने कहा कि सरकार कल्याण कर्नाटक में स्टार्टअप्स का समर्थन करने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है। कलबुर्गी का लक्ष्य राज्य GDP में अपना योगदान 1.9% से बढ़ाकर 3% करना है।

items.title_hi: अधिकांश मुद्दे सुलझे, भारत-US व्यापार समझौता 'फिनिशिंग लाइन' के करीब: जयशंकर

items.title: NCRTC to introduce fast Namo Bharat trains from Nov 16, Anand Vihar-Ghaziabad in 8 minutes
items.text: Limited-stop trains to operate on the Delhi-Meerut corridor, covering Anand Vihar to Begumpul in 36 minutes and Ghaziabad to Begumpul in 28 minutes
items.summary: NCRTC will start limited-stop Namo Bharat trains from November 16 on the Delhi-Meerut corridor. The trains will cover Anand Vihar to Begumpul in 36 minutes and Ghaziabad to Begumpul in 28 minutes, with Anand Vihar to Ghaziabad taking just 8 minutes.
items.title_hi: NCRTC 16 नवंबर से तेज नमो भारत ट्रेनें शुरू करेगा, आनंद विहार-गाजियाबाद 8 मिनट में
items.summary_hi: NCRTC 16 नवंबर से दिल्ली-मेरठ कॉरिडोर पर लिमिटेड-स्टॉप नमो भारत ट्रेनें शुरू करेगा। ट्रेनें आनंद विहार से बेगमपुर 36 मिनट में और गाजियाबाद से बेगमपुर 28 मिनट में पहुंचेंगी, जबकि आनंद विहार से गाजियाबाद केवल 8 मिनट में।

items.title: Magnitude-4 moderate earthquake hits Assam
items.text: The National Centre for Seismology said the quake was recorded at 2.43 pm in Kamrup district at a depth of 10 km
items.summary: A magnitude-4 moderate earthquake struck Assam. The National Centre for Seismology recorded it at 2.43 pm in Kamrup district at a depth of 10 km.
items.title_hi: असम में मध्यम तीव्रता का 4 मैग्नीट्यूड भूकंप
items.summary_hi: असम में 4 मैग्नीट्यूड का मध्यम भूकंप आया। नेशनल सेंटर फॉर सीस्मोलॉजी ने इसे दोपहर 2.43 बजे कामरूप जिले में 10 किमी की गहराई पर दर्ज किया।

items.title: Karnataka Woman, Presumed Dead, Found Alive After 7 Years By Her 'Murderer'
items.text: While out on bail, Rajesh consistently maintained his innocence. Through an independent inquiry, his legal team tracked Manju down near Mandya's Nagamangala area, where she was living with her husband.
items.summary: A Karnataka woman presumed dead for seven years was found alive near Mandya's Nagamangala area living with her husband. The man accused of her murder, Rajesh, maintained his innocence while on bail and his legal team located her through independent inquiry.
items.title_hi: कर्नाटक की महिला, जिसे मृत मान लिया गया था, 7 साल बाद अपने 'हत्यारे' द्वारा जीवित मिली
items.summary_hi: कर्नाटक की एक महिला जिसे 7 साल से मृत माना जा रहा था, मांड्या के नागमंगला इलाके के पास अपने पति के साथ जीवित मिली। जिस व्यक्ति पर उसकी हत्या का आरोप था, राजेश ने जमानत पर रहते हुए अपनी बेगुनाही कायम रखी और उसकी कानूनी टीम ने स्वतंत्र जांच के जरिए उसे ढूंढा।

items.title: Will R&AW’s overseas operations affect ties? | Explained
items.text: Why have the U.S., Canada, Australia and Pakistan brought up allegations that the agency has spearheaded targeted killings and surveillance of separatists on their soil? What is the Indian government’s stand? Do these operations follow certain norms, especially if it’s a friendly country?
items.summary: An explainer examines whether R&AW's overseas operations will affect international ties. The U.S., Canada, Australia and Pakistan have alleged the agency carried out targeted killings and surveillance of separatists on their soil. The piece questions the Indian government's stand and whether norms are followed, especially with friendly countries.
items.title_hi: क्या R&AW के विदेशी अभियान संबंधों को प्रभावित करेंगे? | व्याख्या
items.summary_hi: एक व्याख्या जांच करती है कि क्या R&AW के विदेशी अभियान अंतरराष्ट्रीय संबंधों को प्रभावित करेंगे। अमेरिका, कनाडा, ऑस्ट्रेलिया और पाकिस्तान ने आरोप लगाया है कि एजेंसी ने उनकी धरती पर अलगाववादियों की लक्षित हत्याएं और निगरानी की। लेख भारत सरकार के रुख और क्या मानदंडों का पालन किया जाता है, खासकर मित्र देशों के साथ, पर सवाल उठाता है।

items.title: "Hope they will corner government on sentimental issues": Akhilesh Yadav welcomes AIMIM-Azad Party (Kanshiram) alliance ahead of 2027 UP polls
items.text: Yadav said, "It is good because people would not get carried away emotionally. The basic questions will be raised. The way the government gets votes by using slogans or sentimental issues against the PDA community, I hope this alliance will corner the government on emotional issues."
items.summary: Akhilesh Yadav welcomed the alliance between AIMIM and Azad Party (Kanshiram) ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh polls. He said the alliance would prevent people from being swayed emotionally and would corner the government on sentimental issues used against the PDA community.
items.title_hi: "वे भावनात्मक मुद्दों पर सरकार को घेरेंगे": अखिलेश यादव ने 2027 यूपी चुनाव से पहले AIMIM-आज़ाद पार्टी (कांशीराम) गठबंधन का स्वागत किया
items.summary_hi: अखिलेश यादव ने 2027 यूपी चुनाव से पहले AIMIM और आज़ाद पार्टी (कांशीराम) के गठबंधन का स्वागत किया। उन्होंने कहा कि यह गठबंधन लोगों को भावनाओं में बहने से रोकेगा और PDA समुदाय के खिलाफ इस्तेमाल होने वाले भावनात्मक मुद्दों पर सरकार को घेरेगा।

items.title: Indian Railways to connect Nepal’s Janakpur Dham with Ayodhya through weekly train service
items.text: The train will have stoppages at Jaynagar, Madhubani, Shisho, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, Narkatiaganj, Gorakhpur, Basti, Mankapur, and Ayodhya Dham, besides its terminal stations
items.summary: Indian Railways will connect Nepal's Janakpur Dham with Ayodhya through a weekly train service. The train will stop at several stations including Jaynagar, Madhubani, Sitamarhi, Gorakhpur, and Ayodhya Dham.

items.title: NVIDIA shareholder Leo KoGuan backs Jensen Huang! Explains why he will not add more stake in flagship AI stock
items.text: Investor Leo KoGuan plans to reduce his Nvidia investment while continuing to support Jensen Huang, whom he hopes to back in a future superintelligence venture. KoGuan says Nvidia’s growth outlook remains strong and that AI is not a bubble.
items.summary: Investor Leo KoGuan plans to reduce his Nvidia investment while continuing to support CEO Jensen Huang. He says Nvidia's growth outlook remains strong and that AI is not a bubble.
items.title_hi: NVIDIA शेयरधारक लियो कोगुआन ने जेन्सेन हुआंग का समर्थन किया! बताया कि वह फ्लैगशिप AI स्टॉक में और हिस्सेदारी क्यों नहीं बढ़ाएंगे
items.summary_hi: निवेशक लियो कोगुआन Nvidia में अपना निवेश कम करने की योजना बना रहे हैं लेकिन CEO जेन्सेन हुआंग का समर्थन जारी रखेंगे। उनका कहना है कि Nvidia की वृद्धि संभावनाएं मजबूत हैं और AI कोई बुलबुला नहीं है।

items.title: Toddler Playing Near Bengaluru Factory Falls Into Bucket Of Hot Chemicals, Dies
items.text: Subramani was playing with his eight-year-old sister near their house when he accidentally fell into a bucket of hot chemicals at the nearby Shivam Copper Maker Factory.
items.summary: A toddler named Subramani died after accidentally falling into a bucket of hot chemicals at the Shivam Copper Maker Factory near his house in Bengaluru. He was playing with his eight-year-old sister when the incident occurred.
items.title_hi: बेंगलुरु फैक्ट्री के पास गरम रसायनों की बाल्टी में गिरकर बच्चे की मौत
items.summary_hi: बेंगलुरु में शिवम कॉपर मेकर फैक्ट्री के पास खेलते समय सुब्रमणि नाम का एक बच्चा गरम रसायनों की बाल्टी में गिर गया और उसकी मौत हो गई। वह अपनी आठ साल की बहन के साथ खेल रहा था जब यह हादसा हुआ।

items.title: Rajasthan Board 2027 Exams: Class 10, 12 Papers Deferred Due To Census
items.text: The RBSE class 10, 12 board examination 2027 has been postponed due to Census. The revised exam schedule is yet to be announced by the exam-conducting body.
items.summary: The Rajasthan Board has postponed the 2027 Class 10 and 12 exams due to the Census. The revised schedule has not been announced yet.

items.summary_hi: राजस्थान बोर्ड ने जनगणना के कारण 2027 की कक्षा 10 और 12 की परीक्षाएं स्थगित कर दी हैं। संशोधित परीक्षा कार्यक्रम अभी घोषित नहीं किया गया है।

items.title: Rahul Gandhi calls out ‘fascists’ at Bharat Summit, launches Telangana gig workers’ welfare scheme
items.text: Addressing the Bharat Summit 2026 in Hyderabad, Gandhi hit out at what he termed "fascists" in business, academia, and politics, asserting that they tend to scream and refuse to listen while the humble majority remains quieter.
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi addressed the Bharat Summit 2026 in Hyderabad and criticised what he called "fascists" in business, academia, and politics. He also launched a welfare scheme for gig workers in Telangana.
items.title_hi: राहुल गांधी ने भारत समिट में 'फासीवादियों' की आलोचना की, तेलंगाना गिग वर्कर्स कल्याण योजना शुरू की
items.summary_hi: हैदराबाद में भारत समिट 2026 को संबोधित करते हुए राहुल गांधी ने कारोबार, शिक्षा और राजनीति में जिसे उन्होंने 'फासीवादी' कहा, उनकी आलोचना की। उन्होंने तेलंगाना में गिग वर्कर्स के लिए एक कल्याण योजना भी शुरू की।

items.title: Why your monthly grocery bill is rising: Onion prices jump 116%, garlic 61% as South India feels inflation heat
items.text: Rising food prices are putting pressure on household budgets, with onion inflation at 116% and garlic at 61% in October. All five southern states recorded retail inflation above the national average of 6.09%, adding to the cost of everyday expenses.
items.summary: Onion prices have jumped 116% and garlic prices 61% in October. All five southern states recorded retail inflation above the national average of 6.09%, increasing household expenses.
items.title_hi: आपका मासिक किराना बिल क्यों बढ़ रहा है: प्याज की कीमतें 116%, लहसुन 61% उछले क्योंकि दक्षिण भारत महंगाई की मार झेल रहा है
items.summary_hi: अक्टूबर में प्याज की कीमतें 116% और लहसुन की 61% बढ़ी हैं। सभी पांच दक्षिणी राज्यों में खुदरा महंगाई राष्ट्रीय औसत 6.09% से ऊपर दर्ज की गई, जिससे घरेलू खर्च बढ़ गए हैं।

items.text: Police examined CCTV footage and traced her to the bus station area. The footage showed her arriving at Ramaiah Lodge with a young man identified as Ramu.

items.title: Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
items.text: Yes Bank has filed a petition with the Supreme Court to review an order from October 15. This order upheld a Bombay High Court ruling that quashed the bank's decision to write off AT-1 bonds. These bonds, worth Rs 8,415 crore, were questioned during Yes Bank's financial difficulties. The high court ruled that the bank's administrator lacked authority for such a write-off.
items.summary: Yes Bank has filed a Supreme Court petition to review an October 15 order that upheld a Bombay High Court ruling. The high court had quashed the bank's decision to write off AT-1 bonds worth Rs 8,415 crore, stating the administrator lacked authority.
items.title_hi: यस बैंक SC गया Rs 8,415 करोड़ AT-1 बॉन्ड राइट-ऑफ के आदेश की समीक्षा मांगने
items.summary_hi: यस बैंक ने 15 अक्टूबर के आदेश की समीक्षा के लिए सुप्रीम कोर्ट में याचिका दायर की है जिसने बॉम्बे हाई कोर्ट के फैसले को बरकरार रखा था। हाई कोर्ट ने Rs 8,415 करोड़ के AT-1 बॉन्ड राइट-ऑफ को रद्द कर दिया था, यह कहते हुए कि प्रशासक के पास ऐसा करने का अधिकार नहीं था।

items.title: RHI Magnesita Q2 net profit jumps 62 pc to over Rs 62 cr
items.text: RHI Magnesita has reported a remarkable surge in net profit, soaring to Rs 62.09 crore for the September quarter. The consolidated revenues experienced a modest increase, hitting Rs 1,038.26 crore this period. Additionally, overall expenses decreased to Rs 953.06 crore compared to the last year. EBITDA saw a 30 percent growth, reflecting operational enhancements despite challenging economic conditions.
items.summary: RHI Magnesita's Q2 net profit jumped 62% to over ₹62 crore while consolidated revenue reached ₹1,038.26 crore. Expenses decreased to ₹953.06 crore and EBITDA grew 30%.
items.title_hi: RHI मैग्नेसिटा Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 62% बढ़कर ₹62 करोड़ से अधिक
items.summary_hi: RHI मैग्नेसिटा का Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 62% बढ़कर ₹62.09 करोड़ हो गया जबकि समेकित राजस्व ₹1,038.26 करोड़ रहा। खर्च घटकर ₹953.06 करोड़ रह गए और EBITDA में 30% वृद्धि हुई।

items.text: Microsoft restored Outlook, Teams, Copilot and other Microsoft 365 services after a global outage lasting more than 24 hours and affecting users in over 70 countries. Microsoft ruled out a cyberattack; its shares closed nearly flat.
items.summary: Microsoft restored its Microsoft 365 services after a global outage lasting over 24 hours affecting users in more than 70 countries. The company ruled out a cyberattack, and its shares closed nearly flat despite the outage.

items.text: Noel Tata warned that listing Tata Sons could shift the group’s priorities toward shareholder returns and away from philanthropy. He said Tata Trusts would work with regulators and stakeholders to preserve conglomerate’s existing philosophy amid an ongoing dispute over its listing requirements.
items.summary: Noel Tata warned that listing Tata Sons could shift the group's focus toward shareholder returns and away from philanthropy. He said Tata Trusts would work with regulators and stakeholders to preserve the conglomerate's philosophy amid a dispute over listing requirements.

items.title: Paramilitary Jawan Sacked For Threatening To Kill Commander On Social Media
items.text: Taking serious note of the post, the battalion's Commanding Officer conducted an inquiry. Following the probe, the constable was terminated from service on Friday.
items.summary: A paramilitary jawan was sacked for threatening to kill his commander on social media. The battalion's Commanding Officer conducted an inquiry and the constable was terminated from service on Friday.

items.title: Patanjali Foods Q2 FY27 results: Net profit falls 19% to ₹420 crore
items.text: Patanjali Foods Ltd on Saturday reported 19 per cent fall in consolidated net profit at Rs 419.76 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 despite rise in revenue. Its net profit stood at Rs 516.69 crore in the year-ago period. Total income rose to Rs 11,406.49 crore in the second quarter of the current fiscal from Rs 9,850.06 crore a year ago, according to a regulatory filing. Total operational expenses went up to Rs 10,997.51 crore from Rs 9,344.97 crore. During the first six months of this fiscal, the net profit rose to Rs 755.49 crore from Rs 697.05 crore in the year-ago period. Tota
items.summary: Patanjali Foods reported a 19% fall in Q2 net profit to ₹419.76 crore despite revenue rising to ₹11,406.49 crore. Total income increased from ₹9,850.06 crore a year ago while operational expenses rose to ₹10,997.51 crore.
items.title_hi: पतंजलि फूड्स Q2 FY27 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ 19% गिरकर ₹420 करोड़
items.summary_hi: पतंजलि फूड्स का Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 19% गिरकर ₹419.76 करोड़ रहा जबकि राजस्व बढ़कर ₹11,406.49 करोड़ हो गया। कुल आय पिछले साल के ₹9,850.06 करोड़ से बढ़ी और परिचालन खर्च ₹10,997.51 करोड़ हो गए।

items.title: India-US trade deal nearing finish line, may be sealed soon: Jaishankar
items.text: India and the US have sorted out the bulk of the issues relating to the proposed trade deal and it could be sealed "soon" as negotiations are underway to resolve the last stretch of concerns, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said on Saturday. His remarks come a month before Prime Minister Narendra Modi's likely visit to the US for the G20 Summit, on the sidelines of which he and President Donald Trump may meet to review the broader trajectory of bilateral ties and progress on the trade pact. In an interactive session at the HT Leadership Summit, the external affairs minister said the neg
items.summary: India and the US have resolved most issues in their proposed trade deal and it could be sealed soon. Negotiations are ongoing to address the remaining concerns before a likely meeting between the Prime Minister and President Trump at the G20 Summit.
items.title_hi: भारत-अमेरिका व्यापार समझौता अंतिम चरण में, जल्द हो सकता है सील: जयशंकर
items.summary_hi: भारत और अमेरिका ने प्रस्तावित व्यापार समझौते के अधिकांश मुद्दों को सुलझा लिया है और यह जल्द ही अंतिम रूप ले सकता है। G20 शिखर सम्मेलन से पहले प्रधानमंत्री और राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प की संभावित बैठक से पहले शेष चिंताओं को हल करने के लिए बातचीत जारी है।

items.title: Sammaan Capital Q2 FY27 results: Net profit rises 1.25% to ₹312 crore
items.text: Non-bank lender Sammaan Capital on Saturday reported a 1.25 per cent increase in its September quarter net profit to Rs 312.34 crore compared to Rs 308.47 crore in the same quarter of last year. The company had reported a net profit of Rs 243.30 crore in the preceding June quarter. Its total income declined to Rs 1,850.85 crore in the reporting quarter from Rs 2,260.52 crore in the year-ago period, which included a decline in the core interest income to Rs 1,161.26 crore from Rs 1,449.02 crore. Total expenses also declined to Rs 1,426.28 crore from Rs 1,835.49 crore in the year-ago period, as
items.summary: Sammaan Capital's net profit rose 1.25% to ₹312.34 crore in the September quarter compared to last year. Total income fell to ₹1,850.85 crore from ₹2,260.52 crore a year ago. Expenses also decreased.
items.title_hi: सम्मान कैपिटल Q2 FY27 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ 1.25% बढ़कर ₹312 करोड़ हुआ
items.summary_hi: सम्मान कैपिटल का शुद्ध लाभ सितंबर तिमाही में पिछले साल की तुलना में 1.25% बढ़कर ₹312.34 करोड़ हो गया। कुल आय ₹2,260.52 करोड़ से घटकर ₹1,850.85 करोड़ रह गई। खर्च भी कम हुए।

items.title: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for proposed IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore
items.text: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd has filed its Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering with regulatory bodies. This IPO features an offer for sale of roughly 66.18 crore equity shares from Coal India, amounting to a 10 percent stake in the subsidiary MCL. The intended capital raise is around Rs 9,500 crore, with the final execution reliant on regulatory approval and market conditions.
items.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd has filed its Red Herring Prospectus for an IPO worth nearly ₹9,500 crore. The offer for sale involves 66.18 crore equity shares from Coal India, representing a 10% stake in the subsidiary.

items.summary_hi: महानदी कोलफील्ड्स लिमिटेड ने लगभग ₹9,500 करोड़ के IPO के लिए अपना रेड हेरिंग प्रॉस्पेक्टस दाखिल किया है। इसमें कोल इंडिया के 66.18 करोड़ इक्विटी शेयरों की बिक्री पेशकश शामिल है, जो सहायक कंपनी MCL में 10% हिस्सेदारी के बराबर है।

items.title: Hardeep Singh Puri resigns from UP Rajya Sabha seat after re-election from Madhya Pradesh
items.text: Union minister Hardeep Singh Puri resigned from his Rajya Sabha seat from Uttar Pradesh on November 14. Puri had recently been re-elected unopposed to the Upper House from Madhya Pradesh on November 5. His term from Uttar Pradesh was set to end shortly after the resignation. Puri's new term from Madhya Pradesh will continue until April 2030. He has previously held multiple prominent ministerial roles in the Indian government.
items.summary: Union minister Hardeep Singh Puri resigned from his Rajya Sabha seat from Uttar Pradesh. He was recently re-elected unopposed from Madhya Pradesh. His new term will continue until April 2030.

items.title: India's consumption story remains strong, but rural demand faces inflation risks: Report
items.text: India's consumption growth is projected to be robust, driven by a young population and digital adoption. Despite this, rural income pressures and food inflation could pose challenges for near-term demand. Premium products are expected to outperform mass-market categories as consumer preferences evolve. The impact of Super El Nino may exacerbate rural demand issues due to agricultural pressures. Companies must adapt to changing consumer dynamics and enhance operational efficiencies for success.
items.summary: India's consumption growth is projected to remain strong due to a young population and digital adoption. However, rural income pressures and food inflation could challenge near-term demand, while premium products are expected to outperform mass-market categories.

items.title: Binance targets full reopening of withdrawals by next week
items.text: Binance is set to restore withdrawals across all networks and assets by the end of next week. items.title: Tamil Nadu govt imposes stock limits on paddy, rice and pulses amid price rise
items.text: The Tamil Nadu government has set stock limits on essential commodities like rice and pulses to combat price inflation. Wholesalers can stock a maximum of 2,000 metric tonnes of rice, while retailers are restricted to eight tonnes. Miller stock is limited to one month's production capacity, ensuring regular supply. Importers are prohibited from holding stock longer than 45 days post customs clearance, promoting quick turnover.
items.summary: Tamil Nadu government imposed stock limits on paddy, rice and pulses to control price rises. Wholesalers can hold up to 2,000 metric tonnes of rice, retailers up to eight tonnes, millers up to one month's production, and importers must clear stock within 45 days after customs.

The share sale was executed on Friday at an average price of Rs 246.75 apiece, taking the total deal value to Rs 1,885.17 crore. items.summary: SoftBank Group sold a 1.65% stake in Meesho for ₹1,885 crore, reducing its holding from 6.84% to 5.19%. The shares were sold at an average price of ₹246.75 per share via a block deal on the NSE.

items.text: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi claims that Prime Minister Narendra Modi is tapping his phone to monitor him. He asserts that evidence supporting his allegations is stored on his device. Gandhi expressed reluctance to debate Modi in Parliament due to being silenced in the past. He linked his previous accusations to broader concerns about foreign influence and national loyalty. However, he has not provided any evidence to substantiate his phone-tapping claims.
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi alleges PM Modi is tapping his phone but provides no evidence. He says evidence is on his device, avoids Parliament debate, and links to foreign influence concerns.

Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has expressed concerns over missing Hindu voters and the need for inclusion. The party aims to add at least 50 names at every polling booth during this initiative. A workshop was organized to train workers for the special summary revision process.

The party targets adding at least 50 names per polling booth and has held a workshop to train workers for the revision process.

items.title: YES Bank files SC review plea over AT-1 bonds: What does it mean for investors after stock's 15% rebound?

items.title: Tribal ministry cites Manipur tensions to refuse RTI
items.text: Information regarding a proposal to modify the Scheduled Tribes nomenclature in Manipur has not been disclosed. The tribal affairs ministry expressed concerns over potential inter-community tensions in the state. An RTI applicant referenced a government letter from July 2024 that contained the proposal. items.summary: The tribal affairs ministry refused an RTI request about a proposal to change Scheduled Tribes nomenclature in Manipur. The ministry cited concerns about potential inter-community tensions in the state. The information commissioner supported the decision to withhold details about the proposal.

items.title: Black Box Q2 profit rises 30.6% to ₹72.6 crore; revenue up 22.2%
items.text: Essar Group's IT firm Black Box on Friday reported a 30.6 per cent increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 72.68 crore for the July-September quarter of FY27, aided by growth in data centre and enterprise businesses. The Mumbai-headquartered company had posted a net profit of Rs 55.65 crore in the year-ago period, according to a regulatory filing by the company. Black Box's revenue from operations rose 22.2 per cent to Rs 1,936.30 crore, up from Rs 1,584.59 crore in Q2 FY26. Sequentially, the profit and revenue rose 30 per cent and 13 per cent, respectively. items.summary: Black Box's Q2 net profit rose 30.6% to ₹72.68 crore, driven by data centre and enterprise business growth. Revenue increased 22.2% to ₹1,936.30 crore compared to the same quarter last year.

items.title: India imports over half its edible oil, faces food risks: NITI Aayog VC
items.text: India is perhaps still not secure regarding its food supply across the various products, as the country is the world's largest importer of edible oils, NITI Aayog vice-chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri said on Friday. Addressing an event here, Lahiri said India meets more than half of its edible oil needs through imports, and imports are estimated at 17 million metric tonnes, valued at about USD 20 billion. Similarly, India is both the world's largest producer and consumer of pulses, and accounts for roughly a fourth of total global pulse consumption, approximately 25 to 27 million tonnes annually.
items.summary: NITI Aayog vice-chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri said India imports over half its edible oil, facing food supply risks. India is the world's largest importer of edible oils with imports estimated at 17 million metric tonnes valued at about USD 20 billion. India is also both the largest producer and consumer of pulses, accounting for roughly a fourth of global pulse consumption at 25-27 million tonnes annually.
items.title_hi: भारत आधे से अधिक खाद्य तेल आयात करता है, खाद्य जोखिम: NITI Aayog VC
items.summary_hi: NITI Aayog के उपाध्यक्ष अशोक कुमार लाहिड़ी ने कहा कि भारत अपने खाद्य तेल का आधे से अधिक आयात करता है, जिससे खाद्य आपूर्ति जोखिम है। भारत खाद्य तेलों का दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा आयातक है, आयात अनुमानित 17 मिलियन मीट्रिक टन, मूल्य लगभग USD 20 बिलियन। भारत दालों का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक और उपभोक्ता भी है, वैश्विक दाल खपत का लगभग चौथाई हिस्सा 25-27 मिलियन टन सालाना।

items.title: Anthropic IPO share orders from China are said to be rebuffed
items.text: Investors based in mainland China and Hong Kong are excluded from placing orders in Anthropic's IPO. This decision reflects the strategic sensitivities between Washington and Beijing regarding technology advancements. Some investors are exploring alternative methods to participate in the public offering through offshore structures. Anthropic intends to complete its IPO on November 18, pricing the shares ahead of trading the next day.
items.summary: Anthropic has excluded investors from mainland China and Hong Kong from participating in its IPO. The decision reflects US-China technology tensions. The company plans to complete its IPO on November 18 with share pricing before trading begins.

items.title: BofA adds January Fed hike to forecast, says quarterly pace no longer enough
items.text: BofA Global Research anticipates that the Federal Reserve will implement a rate hike in January 2027. This adjustment follows the unexpectedly high Consumer Price Index report for October. Expectations of a 25-basis-point increase are supported by increasing inflation driven by various factors. Other banks like Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank have also revised their forecasts in light of recent data.
items.summary: BofA Global Research now expects a Federal Reserve rate hike in January 2027 after a high October CPI report. They anticipate a 25-basis-point increase due to rising inflation. Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank have also updated their forecasts.
items.title_hi: BofA ने जनवरी फेड दर वृद्धि का अनुमान जोड़ा, कहा तिमाही गति अब पर्याप्त नहीं
items.summary_hi: BofA ग्लोबल रिसर्च को अब जनवरी 2027 में फेडरल रिजर्व द्वारा दर वृद्धि की उम्मीद है। यह अक्टूबर की उच्च CPI रिपोर्ट के बाद है। वे 25 बेसिस पॉइंट वृद्धि का अनुमान लगाते हैं। Goldman Sachs और Deutsche Bank ने भी अपने अनुमान अपडेट किए हैं।

items.summary: Zetwerk's Q2 loss widened 43% to ₹88 crore, but revenue rose 18% to ₹4,599 crore. Adjusted EBITDA grew 31% to ₹171 crore and the order book hit a record high.

items.title: US stocks: US stocks reverse early gains as Nvidia turmoil hits tech sector
items.text: US stocks fell as Nvidia’s leadership turmoil triggered a broad technology selloff, sending the Nasdaq down 1.42% and the S&P 500 nearly 1% lower. Softer-than-expected producer inflation offered little relief as investors weighed the outlook for interest rates and the wider AI trade.

items.title_hi: अमेरिकी शेयर: एनवीडिया के संकट से टेक सेक्टर प्रभावित, अमेरिकी शेयरों की शुरुआती बढ़त पलटी
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी शेयर गिरे क्योंकि एनवीडिया के नेतृत्व संकट ने व्यापक तकनीकी बिकवाली को जन्म दिया। नैस्डैक 1.42% गिरा और एसएंडपी 500 लगभग 1% नीचे आया। अपेक्षा से नरम उत्पादक मुद्रास्फीति ने ब्याज दरों और एआई व्यापार पर चिंताओं को कम नहीं किया।

items.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says on CNBC the Fed needs to guard against demand overheating
items.text: Chicago Fed president Austan Goolsbee stated that inflation has moved beyond temporary energy and tariff-related price shocks. He highlighted that increased demand from the AI buildout is pushing prices higher across many sectors including health care and services. Goolsbee emphasized the importance of upcoming inflation data for determining the Fed's rate increase pace. He noted that currently, there is no clear path back to the 2% inflation target.
items.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the Fed must guard against demand overheating. He stated inflation has moved beyond temporary energy and tariff shocks, with AI-driven demand pushing prices higher across sectors. Goolsbee emphasized upcoming inflation data will determine rate hike pace, and there is no clear path back to the 2% inflation target.
items.title_hi: शिकागो फेड के गूल्सबी ने CNBC पर कहा कि फेड को मांग की अधिकता से बचाव करना चाहिए
items.summary_hi: शिकागो फेड के अध्यक्ष ऑस्टन गूल्सबी ने कहा कि फेड को मांग की अधिकता से बचाव करने की जरूरत है। उन्होंने कहा कि मुद्रास्फीति अस्थायी ऊर्जा और टैरिफ झटकों से आगे बढ़ गई है, और एआई-संचालित मांग कई क्षेत्रों में कीमतों को बढ़ा रही है। गूल्सबी ने आगामी मुद्रास्फीति डेटा के महत्व पर जोर दिया जो दर वृद्धि की गति तय करेगा, और नोट किया कि वर्तमान में 2% मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्य पर वापस जाने का कोई स्पष्ट रास्ता नहीं है।

items.title: Govt notifies commodity contracts as financial products at GIFT IFSC
items.text: The notification brings commodity trading contracts under the IFSCA Act, paving the way for global trading firms and supporting financial services to operate from GIFT IFSC
items.summary: The government has notified commodity contracts as financial products at GIFT IFSC. This brings commodity trading contracts under the IFSCA Act, enabling global trading firms and supporting financial services to operate from GIFT IFSC.
items.title_hi: सरकार ने GIFT IFSC पर कमोडिटी अनुबंधों को वित्तीय उत्पादों के रूप में अधिसूचित किया

items.title: US Treasury chief says Fed should not hike rates over energy shock tied to Iran war
items.text: During his speech, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent advocated for the Federal Reserve to keep an open mind about interest rate adjustments. He pointed out that the current economic indicators could be skewed due to a supply shock from the ongoing conflict in Iran. Despite recent market volatility, Bessent stressed that the US economy remains robust.
items.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the Federal Reserve should not raise interest rates due to an energy shock from the Iran war. He noted that economic indicators may be skewed by a supply shock from the conflict. Bessent emphasized the US economy remains strong despite market volatility.
items.title_hi: अमेरिकी ट्रेजरी प्रमुख ने कहा फेड को ईरान युद्ध से जुड़े ऊर्जा झटके पर दरें नहीं बढ़ानी चाहिए

items.title_hi: Eicher Motors का Q2 मुनाफा 15% बढ़ा क्योंकि Royal Enfield की बिक्री रिकॉर्ड पर

items.summary: ABB India's Q3 net profit rose 11% to ₹440 crore, while revenue increased 19.4% to ₹3,738 crore. The company follows a calendar year fiscal.

items.text: MAN Industries (India) Ltd has announced a substantial increase in consolidated profit after tax during the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations also saw a notable rise year-on-year, reflecting strong performance. The acquisition of National Pipe Company has positively impacted scale and profitability for the firm. Shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz temporarily affected revenue but shipments are being executed.

items.title: Edelweiss Financial Services Q2 FY27 results: Profit rises 18% to ₹207 cr
items.text: Edelweiss Financial Services on Friday reported an 18 per cent growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 207 crore for the second quarter ended September. The company had earned a profit of Rs 175 crore in the corresponding quarter of the preceding fiscal. Total income increased to Rs 2,602 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared to Rs 1,900 crore in the year-ago period, Edelweiss Financial Services said in a regulatory filing. Interest income rose to Rs 720 crore from Rs 687 crore in the same quarter a year ago. During the quarter, total expenses also rose to Rs 2,393 crore from Rs 1,946
items.summary: Edelweiss Financial Services' Q2 FY27 profit rose 18% to ₹207 crore, with total income increasing to ₹2,602 crore from ₹1,900 crore a year ago. Interest income rose to ₹720 crore.

items.summary: 23 people were killed and 7 injured in a truck-bus collision near Kaziranga in Assam. The accident occurred at Rongajan when a truck hit a minibus traveling from Bokakhat to Nagaon.
items.title_hi: असम के काजीरंगा में ट्रक-बस टक्कर में 23 मरे, 7 घायल

items.title: Rahul Gandhi files reply in defamation case linked to Hathras gangrape case
items.text: Rahul Gandhi has submitted his reply regarding the defamation complaint related to his statements in Hathras. The court previously dismissed the complaint, prompting Gandhi to challenge this decision. Legal representation for three acquitted men claims Gandhi's remarks were defamatory and insulted them. A notice seeking damages was issued to Gandhi after his comments during a village visit. The next hearing is scheduled for December 7, following the judge's leave.
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi has filed a reply in a defamation case linked to his statements about the Hathras gangrape case. The court had earlier dismissed the complaint, and Gandhi challenged that decision. The next hearing is set for December 7.

items.title: Jagatjit Industries Q2 net loss narrows to Rs 4 cr, revenue rises 90%
items.text: Jagatjit Industries Ltd has reported a net loss of Rs 3.96 crore for the second quarter of FY27, significantly improving from Rs 27.91 crore lost during the same period last year. Total income surged to Rs 195.43 crore, up from Rs 103.11 crore. In the first half of FY27, the company posted an overall net loss of Rs 12.23 crore, a decrease from Rs 37.81 crore.
items.summary: Jagatjit Industries reported a net loss of ₹3.96 crore for Q2, significantly lower than the ₹27.91 crore loss a year ago. Total income rose to ₹195.43 crore from ₹103.11 crore.
items.title_hi: Jagatjit Industries Q2 शुद्ध घाटा घटकर ₹4 करोड़, राजस्व 90% बढ़ा

items.title: Trade deficit widens to 1-year high of $39.88 billion in October on record imports
items.text: Exports and imports both recorded strong growth during the month, although the increase in imports outpaced export growth in absolute terms
items.summary: India's trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October due to record imports. Both exports and imports grew strongly, but import growth outpaced export growth.
items.title_hi: अक्टूबर में रिकॉर्ड आयात से व्यापार घाटा एक साल के उच्च स्तर $39.88 बिलियन तक बढ़ा

items.title: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Markets snap 3-day rally; Sensex drops 318 points, Nifty slips below 25,150
items.text: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended lower on Friday, snapping a three-day rally amid anticipation of a policy rate hike by the RBI next month after retail inflation surged to 6.09 per cent in October.
items.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended lower on Friday, snapping a three-day rally. The decline came amid expectations of an RBI policy rate hike next month after retail inflation rose to 6.09 per cent in October.
items.title_hi: सेंसेक्स आज | शेयर बाजार हाइलाइट्स: बाजार ने 3-दिन की तेजी तोड़ी; सेंसेक्स 318 अंक गिरा, निफ्टी 25,150 से नीचे
items.summary_hi: शुक्रवार को सेंसेक्स और निफ्टी गिरावट के साथ बंद हुए, जिससे तीन दिन की तेजी रुक गई। यह गिरावट अक्टूबर में खुदरा मुद्रास्फीति 6.09 प्रतिशत पहुंचने के बाद अगले महीने RBI द्वारा नीतिगत दर बढ़ाने की उम्मीद के कारण आई।

items.title: Rupee falls 8 paise to close at 94.20 against US dollar
items.text: At the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 94.07 against the dollar. During intra-day trade, it witnessed a high of 94.05 and a low of 94.28
items.summary: The rupee fell 8 paise to close at 94.20 against the US dollar. It opened at 94.07, touched a high of 94.05 and a low of 94.28 during intra-day trade.
items.title_hi: रुपया 8 पैसे गिरकर 94.20 प्रति अमेरिकी डॉलर पर बंद

items.title: Gem, jewellery exports up 34% on growing demand, rise in gold prices
items.text: Strong gold jewellery shipments and a recovery in polished diamond exports drive growth ahead of the crucial year-end holiday season.
items.summary: Gem and jewellery exports have risen 34% due to higher demand and increasing gold prices. Strong gold jewellery shipments and a recovery in polished diamond exports are driving this growth ahead of the year-end holiday season.
items.title_hi: रत्न, आभूषण निर्यात 34% बढ़ा बढ़ती मांग और सोने की कीमतों में वृद्धि पर
items.summary_hi: रत्न और आभूषण निर्यात 34% बढ़ा है क्योंकि मांग बढ़ी है और सोने की कीमतें बढ़ी हैं। मजबूत सोने के आभूषण शिपमेंट और पॉलिश किए गए हीरे के निर्यात में सुधार से यह वृद्धि हो रही है।

items.text: PSU banking stocks rallied for a third straight week, lifting the Nifty PSU Bank index 8% to its highest level since March. Among individual stocks, Punjab National Bank emerged as the top performer, surging 13.3% to ₹143.

items.title: Rahul Gandhi, his family and party never respected Constitution, Ambedkar: Chirag Paswan
items.text: Chirag Paswan accused Rahul Gandhi and Congress leaders of disrespecting the Constitution and BR Ambedkar. He highlighted that Prime Minister Modi demonstrated his respect for the Constitution upon assuming office. Paswan also mentioned the speculation about a special Parliament session to advance a controversial delimitation bill. He claimed some Congress MPs support the proposal despite their leadership's objection.
items.summary: Chirag Paswan accused Rahul Gandhi and Congress leaders of disrespecting the Constitution and B.R. Ambedkar. He said Prime Minister Modi showed respect for the Constitution on taking office. Paswan also mentioned speculation about a special Parliament session for a delimitation bill.
items.title_hi: राहुल गांधी, उनका परिवार और पार्टी कभी संविधान, अंबेडकर का सम्मान नहीं करते: चिराग पासवान
items.summary_hi: चिराग पासवान ने राहुल गांधी और कांग्रेस नेताओं पर संविधान और बी.आर. अंबेडकर का अपमान करने का आरोप लगाया। उन्होंने कहा कि प्रधानमंत्री मोदी ने पद संभालते ही संविधान का सम्मान दिखाया। पासवान ने परिसीमन बिल के लिए विशेष संसद सत्र की अटकलों का भी जिक्र किया।

items.text: The assurance follows a customs dispute over dozens of containers held at Indian ports, raising questions about the trade pact’s implementation
items.summary: India will honour a 75% import duty concession on bulk Scotch whisky from the UK. The assurance comes after a customs dispute over dozens of containers held at Indian ports raised questions about the trade pact's implementation.
items.title_hi: भारत UK से बल्क स्कॉच पर 75% आयात शुल्क रियायत का सम्मान करेगा, व्यापार सचिव ने कहा

items.title: Natco Pharma Q2 results: Net profit declines 60.8% to ₹202.6 crore
items.text: Natco Pharma on Friday posted a 60.8 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 202.6 crore during the September quarter, weighed down by a fall in revenues. The pharma company had reported a net profit of Rs 517.9 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding fiscal. Its revenue from operations declined to Rs 967.3 crore in the second quarter of FY27 from Rs 1,363 crore a year ago, the company said in a regulatory filing. Total expenses stood at Rs 776.2 crore, down from Rs 849.3 crore a year ago, it said. During the quarter, Natco acquired an additional 13.25 per cent stake in Ad
items.summary: Natco Pharma's consolidated net profit fell 60.8 percent to ₹202.6 crore in the September quarter. Revenue from operations dropped to ₹967.3 crore from ₹1,363 crore a year earlier.
items.title_hi: नैटको फार्मा Q2 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ 60.8% गिरकर ₹202.6 करोड़
items.summary_hi: सितंबर तिमाही में नैटको फार्मा का समेकित शुद्ध लाभ 60.8 प्रतिशत घटकर ₹202.6 करोड़ रहा। परिचालन राजस्व ₹1,363 करोड़ से गिरकर ₹967.3 करोड़ पर आ गया।
items.key_numbers: Profit ₹202.6 cr (−60.8% YoY) · Revenue ₹967.3 cr (from ₹1,363 cr YoY)

items.title: India's fuel demand to keep rising through 2034 despite EV adoption
items.text: Fuel demand from road transport will peak at more than 2.5 million barrels a day in eight years before gradually declining, according to BloombergNEF's India Electric Vehicle Outlook 2026
items.summary: India's fuel demand will continue to rise through 2034 despite electric vehicle adoption. Road transport fuel demand is expected to peak at over 2.5 million barrels per day in eight years before declining gradually.
items.title_hi: ईवी अपनाने के बावजूद 2034 तक भारत की ईंधन मांग बढ़ती रहेगी
items.summary_hi: ब्लूमबर्गएनईएफ के इंडिया इलेक्ट्रिक व्हीकल आउटलुक 2026 के अनुसार, सड़क परिवहन से ईंधन मांग आठ वर्षों में 2.5 मिलियन बैरल प्रति दिन से अधिक पर चरम पर पहुंचने के बाद धीरे-धीरे घटेगी। इसके बावजूद, ईवी अपनाने के बावजूद 2034 तक भारत की कुल ईंधन मांग बढ़ती रहेगी।

items.title: India's gold imports plunge 62.57% to $5.51 billion in October as prices fall below $4,000/oz
items.text: India's gold imports fell 39.9% to $24.78 billion during April-October 2026, down from $41.24 billion a year ago, according to Commerce Ministry data. October imports plunged 62.57% year-on-year to $5.51 billion amid a correction in global gold prices. Meanwhile, India's gems and jewellery exports rose to $18.50 billion during the seven-month period.
items.summary: India's gold imports plunged 62.57% to $5.51 billion in October as global prices fell below $4,000 per ounce. For April-October 2026, gold imports fell 39.9% to $24.78 billion from $41.24 billion a year earlier. Meanwhile, gems and jewellery exports rose to $18.50 billion in the seven-month period.
items.title_hi: सोने की कीमतें $4,000/औंस से नीचे आने पर अक्टूबर में भारत का सोना आयात 62.57% गिरकर $5.51 बिलियन रह गया
items.summary_hi: वैश्विक कीमतों में गिरावट के कारण अक्टूबर में भारत का सोना आयात 62.57% गिरकर $5.51 बिलियन हो गया। अप्रैल-अक्टूबर 2026 के दौरान सोना आयात 39.9% घटकर $24.78 बिलियन रह गया, जो एक साल पहले $41.24 बिलियन था। इस बीच, सात महीनों की अवधि में रत्न और आभूषण निर्यात बढ़कर $18.50 बिलियन हो गया।

items.title: Indian rupee snaps rising streak on hawkish Fed, oil rise
items.text: In the past week, the Indian rupee faced downward pressure due to escalating oil prices. Although foreign investments offered some relief, they were insufficient to trigger a notable rebound. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to step in to boost forex reserves when the rupee shows strength. Furthermore, India's trade deficit in merchandise hit a yearly peak, compounding the rupee's challenges.
items.summary: The Indian rupee came under pressure from rising oil prices and a hawkish US Federal Reserve. Foreign investments provided some support but were not enough for a rebound. The RBI may intervene to boost forex reserves, while the merchandise trade deficit hit a yearly high.
items.title_hi: भारतीय रुपया आक्रामक फेड और तेल वृद्धि पर गिरा
items.summary_hi: कच्चे तेल की कीमतें बढ़ने और अमेरिकी फेड के आक्रामक रुख से भारतीय रुपये पर दबाव पड़ा। विदेशी निवेश से कुछ राहत मिली लेकिन यह उल्लेखनीय सुधार के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं था। RBI विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार बढ़ाने के लिए हस्तक्षेप कर सकता है, जबकि वस्तु व्यापार घाटा वार्षिक उच्च स्तर पर पहुंच गया।

items.title: Circuit-to-circuit stock SC Agrotech declares 4:5 bonus, 1:10 stock split, dividend update; record date, other details

The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to raise interest rates by 25 basis points to manage retail inflation. Factors such as weak monsoon and high energy prices contribute to the rising inflation. Many essential food items are experiencing upward price pressure amid ongoing inflationary trends.
items.summary: Food inflation is expected to stay high due to crop shortfalls. ICICI Bank predicts a 25 basis point RBI rate hike in December. Weak monsoon and high energy prices are adding to inflationary pressures.

items.title: TNPDCL seeks nod to procure 3,000 MW
items.text: The TNPDCL, which submitted the proposal to procure 1,500 MW to the Tamil Nadu Electricity Regulatory Commission (TNERC) in February this year, has now doubled the quantum
items.summary: TNPDCL has asked for approval to buy 3,000 MW of power. It earlier sought 1,500 MW in February and has now doubled that request to the Tamil Nadu Electricity Regulatory Commission.
items.title_hi: TNPDCL ने 3,000 MW खरीदने की मंजूरी मांगी
items.summary_hi: TNPDCL ने 3,000 MW बिजली खरीदने की अनुमति मांगी है। इसने फरवरी में 1,500 MW का प्रस्ताव दिया था और अब तमिलनाडु विद्युत नियामक आयोग के सामने मांग दोगुनी कर दी है।

items.title: Trafigura Is Key Player in LME Aluminum Squeeze With China Trade
items.text: Trafigura Group has bought up significant volumes of aluminum on the London Metal Exchange, making it a key player in a historic squeeze as inventories of the metal plunge.
items.summary: Trafigura Group has bought significant volumes of aluminum on the London Metal Exchange. This makes it a key player in a historic squeeze as aluminum inventories plunge.
items.title_hi: ट्रैफिगुरा LME एल्युमिनियम स्क्वीज में चीन व्यापार के साथ प्रमुख खिलाड़ी
items.summary_hi: ट्रैफिगुरा समूह ने लंदन मेटल एक्सचेंज पर एल्युमिनियम की महत्वपूर्ण मात्रा खरीदी है। इससे यह एक ऐतिहासिक स्क्वीज में प्रमुख खिलाड़ी बन गया है क्योंकि एल्युमिनियम की इन्वेंट्री तेजी से गिर रही है।

items.title: US stocks: Retail buyers limit Nvidia stock rout
items.text: Retail investors poured a record $111 million into Nvidia shares during Thursday’s first half-hour of trading, helping the stock trim an opening loss of as much as 14% to about 5%. The dip-buying suggests confidence in the AI trade remains resilient despite CEO Jensen Huang’s departure and Nvidia’s loss of more than $1 trillion in market value over five weeks.
items.summary: Retail investors poured a record $111 million into Nvidia shares in the first half-hour of trading, reducing an opening loss from 14% to about 5%. This dip-buying shows continued confidence in AI despite CEO Jensen Huang's departure and a $1 trillion market value loss over five weeks.
items.title_hi: US स्टॉक्स: रिटेल खरीदारों ने Nvidia स्टॉक की गिरावट को सीमित किया
items.summary_hi: रिटेल निवेशकों ने ट्रेडिंग के पहले आधे घंटे में Nvidia शेयरों में रिकॉर्ड $111 मिलियन डाले, जिससे शुरुआती 14% की गिरावट लगभग 5% तक सीमित हो गई। यह डिप-बाइंग AI ट्रेड में विश्वास दिखाती है, भले ही CEO जेन्सेन हुआंग के जाने और पांच हफ्तों में $1 ट्रिलियन से अधिक के मार्केट वैल्यू नुकसान के बावजूद।

items.title: Five held for kidnapping, assaulting youth in Keralam’s Tirur
Three of Malappuram family killed in Fujairah road crash
items.summary: Three members of a Malappuram family were killed in a road crash in Fujairah.
items.title_hi: फुजैरा सड़क हादसे में मलप्पुरम परिवार के तीन लोग मारे गए
items.summary_hi: मलप्पुरम के एक परिवार के तीन सदस्य फुजैरा में एक सड़क दुर्घटना में मारे गए।

items.title: US Fed sets new meeting schedule for 2027, as foretold by Chairman Kevin Warsh
items.text: The Federal Reserve will hold seven rate-setting meetings in 2027 instead of the customary eight, while dedicating its October gathering to broader monetary-policy strategy. The revised schedule also moves the year’s final policy meeting to November and removes designations for quarterly economic projections as Chair Kevin Warsh reviews the Fed’s communication practices.
items.summary: The Federal Reserve will hold seven rate-setting meetings in 2027 instead of eight, with the October meeting focused on monetary-policy strategy. The final meeting moves to November and quarterly economic projections are removed as Chair Kevin Warsh reviews communication practices.
items.title_hi: US फेड ने 2027 के लिए नया मीटिंग शेड्यूल तय किया, चेयरमैन केविन वार्श के अनुसार
items.summary_hi: फेडरल रिजर्व 2027 में आठ के बजाय सात रेट-सेटिंग मीटिंग आयोजित करेगा, अक्टूबर की मीटिंग मौद्रिक नीति रणनीति पर केंद्रित होगी। अंतिम मीटिंग नवंबर में स्थानांतरित कर दी गई है और तिमाही आर्थिक अनुमानों को हटा दिया गया है क्योंकि चेयर केविन वार्श संचार प्रथाओं की समीक्षा कर रहे हैं।

items.title: Dutch Lawmakers Back Controversial Bill, Threatening Coalition
items.text: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten made a last-minute bid to keep his government from collapsing as lawmakers backed a controversial wealth tax amendment that could sink his coalition.
items.summary: Dutch lawmakers approved a controversial wealth tax amendment. The move threatens Prime Minister Rob Jetten's coalition government.
items.title_hi: डच सांसदों ने विवादास्पद विधेयक का समर्थन किया, गठबंधन को खतरा
items.summary_hi: डच सांसदों ने विवादास्पद संपत्ति कर संशोधन को मंजूरी दी। यह कदम प्रधानमंत्री रॉब जेटेन की गठबंधन सरकार को खतरे में डालता है।

items.title: Exclusive | Affordablity Is Key To AI Success In India: Peak XV's Rajan Anandan
items.text: "At the end of 2025, India had less than 10,000 active GPUs. But over the last 8-9 months, we have seen a 10-fold increase," Peak XV Managing Director Rajan Anandan told NDTV
items.summary: Peak XV's Rajan Anandan said affordability is key for AI success in India. He noted India had less than 10,000 active GPUs at end of 2025 but saw a 10-fold increase in the last 8-9 months.
items.title_hi: एक्सक्लूसिव | भारत में AI की सफलता के लिए किफायती होना जरूरी: Peak XV के राजन आनंदन
items.summary_hi: Peak XV के राजन आनंदन ने कहा कि भारत में AI की सफलता के लिए किफायती होना जरूरी है। उन्होंने बताया कि 2025 के अंत में भारत में 10,000 से कम सक्रिय GPU थे, लेकिन पिछले 8-9 महीनों में 10 गुना वृद्धि देखी गई।

items.title: Gold drops to over one-year low as fading Middle East peace hopes fan inflation fears
items.text: GLOBAL-PRECIOUS/ (UPDATE 7, GRAPHIC):PRECIOUS-Gold drops to over one-year low as fading Middle East peace hopes fan inflation fears
items.summary: Gold has dropped to an over one-year low. This is due to fading Middle East peace hopes fanning inflation fears.
items.title_hi: सोना एक वर्ष से अधिक के निचले स्तर पर गिरा क्योंकि मध्य पूर्व शांति की धूमिल आशंकाओं ने मुद्रास्फीति की आशंका बढ़ाई
items.summary_hi: सोना एक वर्ष से अधिक के निचले स्तर पर गिर गया है। मध्य पूर्व में शांति की उम्मीदें धूमिल होने से मुद्रास्फीति की आशंकाएं बढ़ी हैं।

items.title: Akali Dal Waris Punjab De urges ECI to expedite its registration as political party
items.text: Akali Dal Waris Punjab De has urged the Election Commission of India to expedite its registration as a political party, alleging that its application has faced undue delay. The party said its application, pending since January 2025, received a positive verification report from the Punjab CEO in April 2026 but the ECI has yet to issue a direction for publication of a public notice.
items.summary: Akali Dal Waris Punjab De has urged the Election Commission of India to speed up its registration as a political party. The application has been pending since January 2025 and received a positive verification report from Punjab CEO in April 2026, but ECI has not yet issued a direction for public notice.
items.title_hi: अकाली दल वारिस पंजाब दे ने ECI से राजनीतिक दल के रूप में पंजीकरण तेज करने का आग्रह किया
items.summary_hi: अकाली दल वारिस पंजाब दे ने भारतीय चुनाव आयोग से राजनीतिक दल के रूप में अपने पंजीकरण में तेजी लाने का आग्रह किया। आवेदन जनवरी 2025 से लंबित है और अप्रैल 2026 में पंजाब CEO से सकारात्मक सत्यापन रिपोर्ट मिली, लेकिन ECI ने अभी तक सार्वजनिक नोटिस के लिए निर्देश जारी नहीं किया है।

items.title: A combination of factors keep Tamil Nadu politics astir despite CM Vijay's popularity
items.text: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay has asked TVK MLAs to remain vigilant against potential attempts to destabilise his government. The caution comes as the six-month bar on moving a no-confidence motion against the government has ended.
items.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay has warned TVK MLAs to stay alert against attempts to destabilise his government. This comes after the six-month restriction on no-confidence motions has ended.
items.title_hi: तमिलनाडु की राजनीति सीएम विजय की लोकप्रियता के बावजूद हलचल में
items.summary_hi: तमिलनाडु के मुख्यमंत्री सी जोसेफ विजय ने TVK विधायकों को अपनी सरकार को अस्थिर करने के प्रयासों के प्रति सतर्क रहने को कहा है। यह चेतावनी सरकार के खिलाफ अविश्वास प्रस्ताव लाने पर छह महीने की रोक समाप्त होने के बाद आई है।

items.title: Telangana CM Reddy appears in court over case booked for covid-19 violations
items.text: Telangana Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy appeared before a local court in connection with a 2021 case alleging violation of Covid-19 norms during the campaign for the Nagarjuna Sagar assembly bypoll. Reddy denied the allegations during his examination. The special court for cases against MPs and MLAs has posted the matter for November 18.
items.summary: Telangana Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy appeared in court for a 2021 case about violating Covid-19 norms during a bypoll campaign. He denied the allegations and the court has scheduled the next hearing for November 18.
items.title_hi: तेलंगाना के CM रेड्डी कोविड-19 उल्लंघन मामले में अदालत में पेश हुए
items.summary_hi: तेलंगाना के मुख्यमंत्री ए रेवंत रेड्डी 2021 के एक मामले में अदालत में पेश हुए जिसमें नगरजुन सागर विधानसभा उपचुनाव प्रचार के दौरान कोविड-19 मानदंडों के उल्लंघन का आरोप है। उन्होंने आरोपों से इनकार किया और विशेष अदालत ने मामले को 18 नवंबर के लिए सूचीबद्ध किया है।

items.title: 4 Food Stalls Destroyed In Fire At Shillong Literary Fest Venue
items.text: A musical programme was still underway at the Shillong Lit Fest venue, but the organisers were forced to halt it due to the fire.
items.summary: A fire destroyed four food stalls at the Shillong Literary Festival venue. A musical programme was ongoing but organisers had to stop it because of the fire.
items.title_hi: शिलांग साहित्य उत्सव स्थल पर आग में 4 खाने के स्टॉल नष्ट
items.summary_hi: शिलांग साहित्य उत्सव स्थल पर आग से चार खाने के स्टॉल नष्ट हो गए। एक संगीत कार्यक्रम चल रहा था लेकिन आयोजकों को आग के कारण इसे रोकना पड़ा।

items.title: Sonam Wangchuk Claims "House Arrest" Amid Planned Ladakh Protest
items.text: Sonam Wangchuk said holding the elections during winter was "unacceptable", as a significant section of Ladakh's population would be away from the region.
items.summary: Sonam Wangchuk claims he is under house arrest amid a planned protest in Ladakh. He said holding elections during winter is unacceptable because many residents would be away.
items.title_hi: सोनम वांगचुक ने "हाउस अरेस्ट" का दावा किया लद्दाख विरोध प्रदर्शन के बीच
items.summary_hi: सोनम वांगचुक का दावा है कि वे लद्दाख में नियोजित विरोध प्रदर्शन के बीच हाउस अरेस्ट में हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि सर्दियों में चुनाव कराना "अस्वीकार्य" है क्योंकि लद्दाख की आबादी का एक बड़ा हिस्सा उस समय क्षेत्र से दूर होता है।

items.title: In Book Scam Order, Madras High Court Judge's Praise For PM's 'Mann Ki Baat'
items.text: The observation was made by Justice G R Swaminathan in his portion of an order passed by a Division Bench, also comprising Justice M D Sumathi, at the court's Madurai Bench on November 11.
items.summary: A Madras High Court judge praised the Prime Minister's 'Mann Ki Baat' programme in a book scam case order. Justice G R Swaminathan made the comment in his part of a division bench order at the Madurai Bench.
items.title_hi: किताब घोटाला आदेश में मद्रास हाई कोर्ट जज ने PM के 'मन की बात' की तारीफ की
items.summary_hi: मद्रास हाई कोर्ट के एक जज ने किताब घोटाला मामले के आदेश में प्रधानमंत्री के 'मन की बात' कार्यक्रम की प्रशंसा की। न्यायमूर्ति G R स्वामीनाथन ने मदुरै बेंच में डिवीजन बेंच के आदेश के अपने हिस्से में यह टिप्पणी की।

items.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr's advisory contract due to Polymarket conflict
items.text: Prediction-market platform Kalshi has ended Donald Trump Jr.’s advisory role by mutual agreement after his venture-capital firm, 1789 Capital, increased its investment in rival Polymarket. Discussions began after 1789 Capital led Polymarket’s latest funding round, according to a Kalshi spokesperson.
items.summary: Kalshi has ended Donald Trump Jr.'s advisory contract by mutual agreement. This followed his venture-capital firm 1789 Capital increasing its investment in rival Polymarket. Discussions began after 1789 Capital led Polymarket's latest funding round.
items.title_hi: कैल्शी ने डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प जूनियर का सलाहकार अनुबंध पॉलीमार्केट विवाद के कारण समाप्त किया
items.summary_hi: कैल्शी ने डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प जूनियर का सलाहकार अनुबंध पारस्परिक सहमति से समाप्त कर दिया है। यह उनकी उद्यम-पूंजी फर्म 1789 कैपिटल द्वारा प्रतिद्वंद्वी पॉलीमार्केट में निवेश बढ़ाने के बाद हुआ। 1789 कैपिटल द्वारा पॉलीमार्केट के नवीनतम फंडिंग राउंड का नेतृत्व करने के बाद चर्चा शुरू हुई।

items.title: Chief Of Congress-Allied Kerala Group Arrested In Extortion Case
items.text: What initially appeared to be an isolated incident of extortion has now snowballed into an investigation into a suspected nationwide fraud network.
items.summary: The leader of a Kerala group allied with the Congress party has been arrested in an extortion case. The case has expanded into a probe of a suspected nationwide fraud network.
items.title_hi: कांग्रेस से जुड़े केरल समूह के प्रमुख को जबरन वसूली मामले में गिरफ्तार किया गया
items.summary_hi: कांग्रेस से संबद्ध एक केरल समूह के नेता को जबरन वसूली मामले में गिरफ्तार किया गया है। यह मामला अब एक संदिग्ध राष्ट्रव्यापी धोखाधड़ी नेटवर्क की जांच में बदल गया है।

items.title: Rail Vikas Nigam in focus today after mixed Q2 performance; stock down 68% from record peak
items.text: Rail Vikas Nigam reported Q2 FY27 net profit growth of 10% to ₹253.71 crore, despite an 8.24% revenue decline. Operating profit rose 19.51%. For H1, net profit increased 13.25% and operating profit surged 62.29%, while revenue was nearly flat.
items.summary: Rail Vikas Nigam reported Q2 FY27 net profit growth of 10% to ₹253.71 crore, despite an 8.24% revenue decline. Operating profit rose 19.51%. For H1, net profit increased 13.25% and operating profit surged 62.29%, while revenue was nearly flat. The stock is down 68% from its record peak.
items.title_hi: मिश्रित Q2 प्रदर्शन के बाद रेल विकास निगम फोकस में; स्टॉक रिकॉर्ड शिखर से 68% नीचे
items.summary_hi: रेल विकास निगम ने Q2 FY27 में शुद्ध लाभ में 10% वृद्धि दर्ज की जो ₹253.71 करोड़ रहा, जबकि राजस्व में 8.24% की गिरावट आई। परिचालन लाभ 19.51% बढ़ा। H1 के लिए, शुद्ध लाभ 13.25% बढ़ा और परिचालन लाभ 62.29% उछला, जबकि राजस्व लगभग स्थिर रहा। स्टॉक अपने रिकॉर्ड शिखर से 68% नीचे है।

items.title: Analysis-From SpaceX to Anthropic, markets have a new playbook for mega-share debuts
items.text: ANTHROPIC-STOCK-INDEX:Analysis-From SpaceX to Anthropic, markets have a new playbook for mega-share debuts
items.summary: Markets have developed a new playbook for mega-share debuts. This applies to companies from SpaceX to Anthropic.
items.title_hi: विश्लेषण: स्पेसएक्स से एंथ्रोपिक तक, बाजारों के पास मेगा-शेयर डेब्यू के लिए नई प्लेबुक है
items.summary_hi: बाजारों ने मेगा-शेयर डेब्यू के लिए एक नई प्लेबुक विकसित की है। यह स्पेसएक्स से एंथ्रोपिक तक की कंपनियों पर लागू होती है।

items.title: In Manipur, Woman Shot Dead, Two Men Injured In Firing At Taphou Village In Kangpokpi
items.text: The firing reportedly occurred while villagers were harvesting paddy. The gunshots triggered panic, forcing farmers to abandon their fields and flee. Villagers of Taphou reportedly alerted travellers to avoid the affected stretch of National Highway 2.
items.summary: A woman was shot dead and two men injured in firing at Taphou village in Kangpokpi, Manipur. The incident occurred while villagers were harvesting paddy. Gunshots caused panic and farmers fled their fields. Villagers warned travellers to avoid the affected stretch of National Highway 2.
items.title_hi: मणिपुर में तफौ गांव में गोलीबारी में महिला की मौत, दो पुरुष घायल
items.summary_hi: मणिपुर के कांगपोकपी में तफौ गांव में गोलीबारी में एक महिला की मौत हो गई और दो पुरुष घायल हो गए। यह घटना तब हुई जब ग्रामीण धान की कटाई कर रहे थे। गोलीबारी से दहशत फैल गई और किसान अपने खेत छोड़कर भाग गए। ग्रामीणों ने यात्रियों को राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग 2 के प्रभावित हिस्से से बचने की चेतावनी दी।

items.title: Christian groups seek withdrawal of FCRA Bill; RSS bodies back proposal
items.text: Christian organisations have sought the withdrawal of the FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026, alleging it could undermine religious freedom and restrict welfare services to marginalised communities. In contrast, RSS-linked organisations have backed the proposed legislation, calling it necessary to regulate foreign funding. The contrasting views were presented before a joint parliamentary committee examining the bill.
items.summary: Christian groups want the FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026 withdrawn, saying it threatens religious freedom and aid to marginalized communities. RSS-linked groups support the bill, saying it is needed to regulate foreign funding. Both sides presented their views to a joint parliamentary committee.
items.title_hi: ईसाई समूहों ने FCRA विधेयक वापस लेने की मांग की; RSS निकायों ने समर्थन किया
items.summary_hi: ईसाई संगठनों ने FCRA संशोधन विधेयक, 2026 वापस लेने की मांग की है, उनका कहना है कि यह धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता और वंचित समुदायों की सहायता को खतरे में डाल सकता है। RSS से जुड़े संगठनों ने विधेयक का समर्थन किया है, उनका कहना है कि विदेशी फंडिंग को नियंत्रित करने के लिए यह जरूरी है। दोनों पक्षों ने संयुक्त संसदीय समिति के सामने अपने विचार रखे।

items.title: Chhath songs at stations spark cultural row in Maharashtra
items.text: The Railways' decision to play Bhojpuri Chhath Puja songs at several Mumbai stations has drawn opposition from Shiv Sena (UBT) and MNS amid tensions over Chhath celebrations in Maharashtra. UBT Sena MP Sanjay Raut questioned the move, alleging that Marathi and national songs are not given similar prominence.
items.summary: Railways decided to play Bhojpuri Chhath Puja songs at several Mumbai stations. Shiv Sena (UBT) and MNS opposed this decision. UBT Sena MP Sanjay Raut questioned why Marathi and national songs are not given similar prominence.
items.title_hi: महाराष्ट्र में स्टेशनों पर छठ गीतों से सांस्कृतिक विवाद
items.summary_hi: रेलवे ने कई मुंबई स्टेशनों पर भोजपुरी छठ पूजा गीत बजाने का फैसला किया। शिव सेना (यूबीटी) और मनसे ने इसका विरोध किया। यूबीटी सांसद संजय राउत ने पूछा कि मराठी और राष्ट्रीय गीतों को समान प्रमुखता क्यों नहीं दी जाती।

items.title: Leh protesters seek statehood, safeguards; Wangchuk removed from site, asked to stay at home
items.text: Protests led by the Apex Body Leh resumed in Leh on Thursday, with demonstrators pressing for statehood and constitutional safeguards for Ladakh. Authorities removed climate activist Sonam Wangchuk from the protest site and directed him to stay home. The Kargil Democratic Alliance has extended support to the agitation and called for a candle march in Kargil on Saturday.
items.summary: Protests led by the Apex Body Leh resumed in Leh demanding statehood and constitutional safeguards for Ladakh. Authorities removed climate activist Sonam Wangchuk from the protest site and directed him to stay home. The Kargil Democratic Alliance extended support and called for a candle march in Kargil on Saturday.
items.title_hi: लेह में प्रदर्शनकारी राज्यhood और सुरक्षा चाहते हैं; वांगचुक को स्थल से हटाया गया
items.summary_hi: एपेक्स बॉडी लेह के नेतृत्व में लेह में विरोध प्रदर्शन फिर से शुरू हुए, जिसमें लद्दाख के लिए राज्यhood और संवैधानिक सुरक्षा की मांग की गई। अधिकारियों ने जलवायु कार्यकर्ता सोनम वांगचुक को विरोध स्थल से हटाकर घर पर रहने का निर्देश दिया। कारगिल डेमोक्रेटिक एलायंस ने आंदोलन का समर्थन किया और शनिवार को कारगिल में कैंडल मार्च का आह्वान किया।

items.title: Bharat Forge to lose subsidiary status of Tork Motors after NCLT approves resolution plan
items.summary: NCLT has approved a resolution plan that will cause Bharat Forge to lose its subsidiary status of Tork Motors.
items.title_hi: NCLT द्वारा समाधान योजना मंजूर करने के बाद भारत फोर्ज टॉर्क मोटर्स की सहायक कंपनी का दर्जा खो देगी
items.summary_hi: NCLT ने एक समाधान योजना मंजूर की है जिससे भारत फोर्ज टॉर्क मोटर्स की सहायक कंपनी का दर्जा खो देगी।

items.title: Automotive Axles Q2 Results: Profit jumps 67% to ₹60 crore, revenue rises 43.5%
items.summary: Automotive Axles reported a 67% jump in profit to ₹60 crore and a 43.5% rise in revenue for Q2.
items.title_hi: ऑटोमोटिव एक्सल्स Q2 परिणाम: मुनाफा 67% बढ़कर ₹60 करोड़, राजस्व 43.5% बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: ऑटोमोटिव एक्सल्स ने Q2 में मुनाफा 67% बढ़कर ₹60 करोड़ और राजस्व 43.5% बढ़ने की सूचना दी।

items.title: Manappuram Finance Q2 results: Profit jumps over 3-fold to ₹701 crore
items.text: Gold loan financier Manappuram Finance Ltd on Thursday reported a more than three-fold year-on-year increase in its consolidated profit after tax (PAT) to Rs 701 crore for the September quarter of FY27. The company had posted a PAT of Rs 217.31 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal. On a sequential basis, net profit rose 20 per cent from Rs 585 crore in the June quarter. Total income increased to Rs 3,312 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared to Rs 2,275 crore in the year-ago period, the company said in a regulatory filing. The company's total assets under managemen
items.summary: Manappuram Finance's profit more than tripled year-on-year to ₹701 crore in Q2 FY27. Total income rose to ₹3,312 crore from ₹2,275 crore a year earlier. Sequentially, net profit grew 20% from ₹585 crore in the previous quarter.
items.title_hi: मनापुरम फाइनेंस Q2 परिणाम: मुनाफा 3 गुना से अधिक बढ़कर ₹701 करोड़
items.summary_hi: मनापुरम फाइनेंस का मुनाफा सालाना आधार पर तीन गुना से अधिक बढ़कर Q2 FY27 में ₹701 करोड़ हो गया। कुल आय ₹2,275 करोड़ से बढ़कर ₹3,312 करोड़ हो गई। क्रमिक आधार पर शुद्ध लाभ पिछली तिमाही के ₹585 करोड़ से 20% बढ़ा।

items.title: Manappuram Finance Q2 results: Profit jumps over 3-fold to ₹701 crore
items.summary: Manappuram Finance reported a more than three-fold jump in profit to ₹701 crore for Q2.
